audit_name: POLARIS EMS HD-01B EBR Resilience Interval N Evidence Audit

governance_scope.topic: Numerical Value for EBR Resilience Interval N

closed_decisions.HD-01A: EBR is dynamic critical-load-based target: E_EBR_target(t) = sum_{k=t+1}^{t+N} D_critical(k) * dt / eta_dis
closed_decisions.HD-01B_architecture: N is FIXED, SEPARATELY GOVERNED, DISTINCT FROM MPC HORIZON H=24h AND T_required

audit_findings.mpc_horizon_conflation: H=24h in milp.py is solver decision horizon; distinct from EBR interval N
audit_findings.survival_window_conflation: T_required is operational resupply window; distinct from EBR interval N
audit_findings.ups_autonomy_conflation: 15 minutes in implementation spec is sub-hourly ATS hold-up time; distinct from hourly EMS policy N
audit_findings.loads_yaml_baseline: 30 kW baseline power in loads.yaml is PROTOTYPE_ASSUMPTION; not station-measured profile
